subject.title: feat: manage iOS notifications from Privacy

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent app-level notification-serving preference in Settings > Privacy that unregisters APNs delivery when turned off?
rationale: This is more than a UI relocation: it creates a new persisted setting and changes notification delivery semantics, so maintainer product intent should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Keep the Privacy-owned toggle direction, but require rebase, localization, typography, and upgrade/opt-out proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to recovery
options.body: Only keep the denied-permission app-settings deep link fix and leave app-level serving preference design for a separate issue.

options.title: Keep separate screen
options.body: Decline the Privacy relocation for now and keep notification controls on their existing Settings destination.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the Privacy-owned toggle direction, but require rebase, localization, typography, and upgrade/opt-out proof before merge.
